desc: These vinyl coated metal handgun racks are extremely handy for use in your gun vault or at the shooting range to provide a safe place to rest your handguns. The individual channels are specially designed to cradle the grip and barrel of the gun and are wide enough to accommodate most wide body pistols or magnum revolvers. Holds 4 or 6 handguns (pistols and/or revolvers). Vinyl coating won't scratch or mar handgun's finish. Use at range to hold handguns while not in use.
